bell.empty: New mail shows here as it arrives.

section.intro: New mail always shows under the bell. While the window is in front it also pops up in the corner; while it is behind, your computer shows a notification.
section.toastsHint: A short note in the corner, gone after a few seconds.
section.desktopRefused: Your system said no. Allow Buun Mail in its notification settings, then try again.
section.desktopAsks: Asks your system the first time.
